fullDescription: A high-end industrial logistics design system featuring a sophisticated dark mode aesthetic with glassmorphism, 3D interactive transforms, and an editorial-style typographic hierarchy. Built with a deep navy palette (#050811), vibrant blue accents (#2563EB), and subtle emerald highlights, this style is ideal for fintech, SaaS dashboards, logistics marketplaces, and enterprise platforms. It employs heavy Cabinet Grotesk headings and clean Satoshi body text, utilizing scroll-triggered entrance animations and mouse-responsive card tilting. Key components include glass-morphic input fields, shimmer-effect cards, and animated gradient backgrounds with carbon-fiber texture overlays.
prompt:
## Resumo
An industrial-tech design system using a dark 'Carbon and Glass' theme, heavy editorial typography, and physics-based 3D micro-interactions for a premium enterprise feel.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design with a deep navy-to-black theme (#050811). Background should feature a 400% size linear gradient animation across #050811, #1E3A8A, and #0F172A moving over 15s. Overlay a carbon-fiber texture pattern at 20% opacity. Use 'Cabinet Grotesk' for headings (bold weights 700-800) and 'Satoshi' for body (weights 400-500). Implement glassmorphism with background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03), backdrop-filter: blur(12px), and 1px solid border: rgba(255,255,255,0.08). Buttons should have a primary blue (#2563EB) fill with a matching shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(37,99,235,0.3). Interactive elements must use 3D perspective (perspective: 1000px) with tilt transforms on hover. Micro-interactions should follow cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1) timing.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Header Navigation
Fixed header with a floating glass-morphic container. Max-width 7xl, rounded-2xl, px-6, py-3. Logo on the left with a blue square icon (#2563EB), navigation links centered in Gray-400 Satoshi (14px font size), and a high-visibility CTA on the right with uppercase, tracking-wider font-bold style. Background must have backdrop-filter: blur(12px) and a subtle white border.

### Focus Utility Card (Login/Sign-up)
Centered card-focused layout. Container max-width 2xl with a 3D tilt effect on mouse movement. Card styling: 2.5rem border-radius, glass background, shimmer animation effect. Internal spacing: p-8 to p-12. Input fields should be 'input-glass' (bg-white/3%, border-white/10%) with 2xl rounding. Form labels in uppercase 10px bold tracking-widest style. Include a high-impact primary button with scale-on-hover (1.02) and active-state compression (0.95).

### Feature Grid
Three-column grid for desktop, stacking for mobile. Each card uses perspective-container logic. Cards feature a 4:3 aspect ratio image with 2rem border-radius. Status badges (e.g., 'Available' in Emerald-500) positioned absolute top-4 left-4. Content area includes 2xl bold titles, amber-400 capacity labels, and 2-column detail blocks with 10px uppercase gray labels.

### Admin Dashboard Preview Section
Split layout: Left side contains editorial typography (text-5xl) and a bulleted list with emerald checkmarks. Right side features a tilted (rotate-3) administrative dashboard preview using stacked glass-morphic metric cards. Cards should show trends with +% values in emerald and icons in blue-500/20 rounded-lg backgrounds.

### Footer
Full-width black/50 background with backdrop-blur-md. Top border 1px white/5. Three-column stack on mobile, horizontal row on desktop. Includes brand signature, navigation links in gray-400 (text-sm), and circular glass-morphic social icons that turn blue (#2563EB) on hover. Centered copyright line at the bottom in text-xs Gray-600.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### 3D Tilt Glass Card — A mouse-responsive card that uses CSS perspective to rotate based on cursor position.
Create a container with perspective: 1000px. The inner card has transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1) and transform-style: preserve-3d. On hover, apply a rotateX and rotateY transform dynamically (max 10 degrees) and a translateY(-10px). The card should have a 'shimmer' pseudo-element: a 45-degree linear gradient (transparent to white/5% to transparent) that translates across the surface on a 6s infinite loop.

### Glass-Morphic Input Field — Modern, deep-themed input fields with focus-state illumination.
Base: bg-white/3%, border: 1px solid white/10%, rounded-2xl, px-4, py-4. Inside a 'group' container to allow icon color changes on focus. Focus state: background-white/6%, border-color: blue-500/50, box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1). Placeholder color: Gray-600. Font: Satoshi 14px.

style.description: The style is defined by a deep navy background (#050811) with a 15-second looping animated gradient. It utilizes 'Cabinet Grotesk' for bold, authoritative headings and 'Satoshi' for modern UI elements. Glassmorphism is central, using ultra-low opacity white backgrounds (rgba(255,255,255,0.03)) paired with sharp borders (rgba(255,255,255,0.08)) and 12px backdrop blurs. Accents include a high-glow blue (#2563EB) for primary actions and soft emerald (#10B981) for success states.
